triggers.description: Owner-issued falsification evidence needs current classification.
A proposed review law must be related to accepted Goal authority.
Several observations may support one same-law observational class.
Evidence may relate to an active eliminated claim.
Admitted counterexamples need durable provenance or historical projection.

routes.description: Return the current analytical Review Fold and capture admitted witnesses.
Block when evidence, authority, applicability, provenance, class basis, or required corpus custody is unknown.

success_signals: claims, facts, repairs, and transport status are separate
historical provenance is preserved
current applicability is judged separately
clean source is representable
failure_signals: review prose selects work
historical evidence is rebound to the current head
unknown evidence is treated as current
a durable Review Fold or applicability snapshot is created
clauses.rationale: Classification remains current analysis over owner evidence.

success_signals: entailed current finding may become accepted
strengthening becomes non-blocking follow-up
preference is rejected
new requirement requests Goal reopening
underdetermined requirement blocks pending authority
failure_signals: reviewer consensus manufactures entailment
optional strengthening blocks closure
preference is treated as a bug
Goal scope is silently broadened
clauses.rationale: Review evidence may falsify accepted semantics but does not own requirements.

success_signals: duplicates collapse without erasing independent witnesses
different detection surfaces may remain one class
observed witnesses do not define the complete family
predicted siblings are distinguished from observed examples
recurrence uses exact projected and current evidence
incomplete historical evidence yields unknown recurrence
failure_signals: file or reviewer identity defines a class
duplicates count as independent witnesses
newly found siblings are called prior predictions
absence in incomplete history is labeled first-observed
Review Fold selects architecture
clauses.rationale: Actuating receives bounded observational evidence rather than a retained class register.

required_artifacts: projected historical counterexamples relevant to the law
same-claim, same-law-different-family, outside-horizon, different-law, or unknown relation with exact basis
success_signals: current entailed same-claim relation is reported only inside the validity horizon
same-law disjoint families do not falsify the scoped claim
strengthening does not retroactively falsify the Goal
new requirement requests Goal reopening
Actuating retains revocation authority
failure_signals: Review Fold revokes or preserves the theory itself
post-elimination relation is inferred from memory
different-law finding is merged into the old family
same law alone revokes a family-scoped claim
out-of-horizon evidence is treated as falsifying the claim
clauses.rationale: Review Fold reports the falsifier relation; Actuating owns its architectural consequence.

required_artifacts: accepted Goal digest and entailed law
current applicability and accepted disposition before capture
success_signals: each independent current entailed accepted witness receives one immutable CEX identity
duplicate reports do not become independent counterexamples
stored rows preserve source facts and semantic admission only
current applicability, class, family, recurrence, owner, cut, carrier, route, and closure are recomputed
missing history yields an incomplete evidence horizon rather than first-observed
failure_signals: CAS transcripts or suggested patches are copied into the corpus
a stored family, owner, cut, carrier, route, or closure verdict becomes authority
capture occurs for strengthening, preference, new requirement, underdetermined, rejected, or non-current evidence
one semantic witness is duplicated by reviewer or thread identity
corpus failure is silently ignored while complete historical claims are made
clauses.rationale: Persist the monotone counterexample source language while recompiling every current interpretation.

instrumentation.rationale: The fold is current analysis; only admitted counterexample witnesses receive durable identities.
